recentItems.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 1/2 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
recentItems.description:
Russell Brand sentenced to 10 and a half years in prison after being convicted of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others. The comedian was cleared of three other charges. Brand had denied all allegations, saying his sexual encounters were consensual.

recentItems.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with suspected Chinese spy as Beijing denies claims
recentItems.description:
Huang has acknowledged he had been intimate with a business executive, issuing an apology to his wife and to the company in an open letter posted on Nvidia's website. He did not name the woman. Nvidia announced Sunday it was conducting an independent investigation into reports that Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.”

(Produced by Aakriti Dhawan)
